remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath Ranch-style first-floor condominium located in the desirable Glendale area of Stamford. This inviting home features an open-concept layout seamlessly connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The modern kitchen boasts a center island, stainless steel appliances, and sleek quartz countertops. Enjoy the warmth and charm of the living room, complete with custom built-ins and a decorative electric fireplace. Hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and air conditioning enhance comfort and style throughout. The spacious primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet, while the second bedroom includes a convenient Murphy bed for flexible use. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer and sliding doors leading to a covered outdoor patio-ideal for relaxing or dining al fresco. The well-maintained complex features an outdoor pool with a pool house and safety fence. One designated parking space is included, along with ample visitor parking. A perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location. Close to downtown Stamford, train and major highways.
